card.name: Countable item nouns after a quantity
card.fires_on: The last piece of a countable object noun that follows a number or quantity word, such as devices, applicators, NSAID or drop, mostly in dosing directions.

modes.label: Units of a product
modes.description: Device or applicator nouns counted in use instructions.

modes.label: End of NSAID after one
modes.description: The final piece of NSAID in 'more than one NSAID'.
modes.example: Avoid administration of more than one NSA<<ID>> at a time.

modes.label: Tools and drops
modes.description: Singular tool or drop nouns after one, second or a measuring word.
modes.example: Instill one<< drop>> of XDEMVY in each eye

card.writes: It seems to suppress plural or group endings, which suggests it favors the end of a counted noun.
card.plain: It fires on the name of a countable item right after a number, as in 'two applicators' or 'one drop'.
